verified.detail: Original claim labelled 1조3000억원 as '(2026)'. At early-2026 rates (≈1,400–1,470 원/$) US$1 bn ≈ 1조4000억~1조4700억원; 1조3000억 reflects ≈1,290–1,300 원/$ of June 2022. Other pairs consistent: 30 bn × 1,340 ≈ 40조; 500 bn × 1,340–1,400 ≈ 670–700조; 7 bn → 9조2580억 implies 1,322.6 원/$.
verified.note: Corrected the date attribution of the 1조3000억원 conversion (2022, not 2026). Rule to reuse press figures stands, but label the year.
